title: Longest Mountain in Array
description: Find the length of the longest subarray that forms a mountain.
pseudocode:
1: let maxLen = 0, i = 1
2: while i < arr.length - 1:
3:   if arr[i-1] < arr[i] > arr[i+1]:
4:     let left = i - 1, right = i + 1
5:     while left > 0 && arr[left-1] < arr[left]: left--
6:     while right < arr.length - 1 && arr[right+1] < arr[right]: right++
7:     maxLen = Math.max(maxLen, right - left + 1)
8:     i = right
9:   i++

steps.note: Check if index 1 is a peak (1 is not > 2 and 4)
Check if index 2 is a peak (4 > 1 and 4 < 7). Not a peak.
Check if index 3 is a peak (7 > 4 and 7 > 3). Found a peak!
Expand left: arr[2]=4 > arr[1]=1. left becomes 1.
Expand right: arr[4]=3 < arr[3]=7, arr[5]=2 < arr[4]=3. right becomes 5.
